verdict.rationale: No evidence states how long a sandbox can stay running, or whether auto-stop or timeout settings exist. The pack only gives indirect support for long tasks: persistent interpreter contexts keep state across executions, and snapshots persist sandbox state (VM hot snapshots include memory), so an agent could preserve and resume work. Missing for 10: documented support for multi-hour or multi-day session lifetimes, configurable auto-stop or timeout controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running sessions.
